scope: A fixed synthetic diagnostic set that separates model selection from application adoption. It is not Sonnet 5 qualification, clinical quality, voice review, corpus/holdout evidence or Word compatibility. All text is synthetic probe or adversarial-test material; no corpus original text is included.

default.note: Production default. Options are filled only from a labelled line.

field_relations.model_response: FieldSelections: fields[{key, unit_ids, conflict, option_ids, context[one of answer|qualifier|independent|contrary|unresolved per unit]}]
field_relations.note: Paused contradiction veto (candidate-adversarial-pass-20260928: not converging, stays off). Never enable on the installed app.

classes.V: explicit, relevant stated content that should be supported; held today by the application
classes.J: field meaning, wording or ownership needs adjudication; must stay held
classes.I: a single-field positive selection would be invalid; a correct model selects nothing or sets conflict
classes.S: supported control (should be and is adopted)
classes.M: missing control (nothing stated; nothing may be adopted)
classes.CONTRADICTION: direct-opposite control: isolated QA of the paused field-relations veto (R3-1..R3-8); N13/N16 also measure the default path, which has no veto

vocabulary.raw_model_expectation: acceptable: every listed selection is correct model behaviour; the FIRST is the reference selection the offline replay feeds the application. forbidden: model errors. units: exact complete source-unit quotes (map them to ids with the candidate's source_units() for the same form). conflict: the model's conflict flag. options and relations exist only on the field_relations path (relations lists units that are not "independent"; selected units are "answer"); a selection with "paths" is only expressible on those paths. A selection matches when its unit set, conflict flag and (field_relations) option set are equal; unit order is irrelevant (the application restores source order).
vocabulary.app_adoption_expectation: desired: what the application SHOULD do with the reference selection - supported (adopted), held (status "conflict", nothing written, a held_candidate may be shown), missing (blank). desired_text: the exact adopted text when supported. never: outcomes that are failures whatever the model returned. observed_offline: what candidate 8e3dcfd0 actually did with that selection on each send path, replayed offline (offline_replay.py), with verdict as_desired | over_hold (desired supported, observed held/missing) | leak (observed supported, desired not) | text_mismatch. An acceptable/forbidden entry carries its own desired (when it differs, "not_asserted" = recorded only), app_should (forbidden: not_supported = the application should catch it, model_dependent = only the model can) and observed_offline.
vocabulary.adversarial_simulations: offline-only inputs, never sent: model mistakes (app_guard), what production adopts when the model misses a conflict (default_exposure), destination trust (model_dependence) and the paused veto with every unselected unit wrongly called independent (veto_qa). expected: held | not_supported (held or missing) | not_yes | model_dependent (recorded only). meets_expected is recorded, not assumed.
vocabulary.send_paths: the provider sends this case needs, one request per path. default = production configuration; field_relations = QUILLMD_V3_FIELD_RELATIONS=1 on an isolated QA stack only.

budget.bound_basis: per send: app maximum_cost = (serialized request bytes + 12000) x input rate + profile max_output_tokens (8000 default, 20000 field_relations) x output rate, at the documented Sonnet 5 $2/$10 per million; customer hold = x1.5. Totals are in offline_replay. No retries are budgeted: a failed or unknown send stays failed.

sources.drawn: r1-note1/3/4/6/10 notes, the r1 11-field form and retained picks (verbatim); the t- notes informed the supported controls only
V/J/I class, next_group and original selection per held field (source_row)
engineering-group meaning and required dispositions (J2/J1/I9/I1; allergy hold retained)
side controls: opposite side held, same side supported
repeated Other: write-in shape, copular "subject to" allowance, ordinary predicate options, field_relations harness offered()
denial and correction controls, default-path harness run()/field()
batch-path side gap and signing-field controls (never requested)
copular-r3 findings R3-1..R3-8 (inputs, expected, verifier reproduction)
